statement.zh: 马里伊什塔尔神庙建筑与出土见 Parrot《马里考古队》I（1956）；王宫档案卷另册，不在本主张范围。
statement.en: At Mari, the Temple of Ishtar architecture and finds are documented in Parrot Mission archéologique de Mari vol. I (1956); palace-archive volumes are separate and out of scope for this claim.
